assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset 01-table-bay-window.png: primary concept master. Input reference 1 kitchen: photographic realism, wood/plaster and light quality; reference 2 material board: shared timber, plaster, metals only, replace marigold with rose/plum; reference 3 hallway: identical oak four-panel door family; reference 4 storybook exterior: building and place context ONLY, do not imitate its illustration treatment or put giant whisk in room. WhiskedAway Sweet Spells, a kindly magician's dessert den in a lived-in English/Kiwi coastal inn. Photographic interiors/cookbook realism, real materials, subtle wear, believable photographed magic, not illustration or glossy CGI. Cream limewash #f4efe4, honey oak exposed beams and worn wide floorboards, aged brass #b07f52, deep brown #2c2416, rose #c27a8c, deep plum velvet drapes, touches of gold. Early evening blue dusk at front bay window mixed with warm beeswax candles, small hearth fire and softly glowing syrup bottles. Full frame 24mm eye-height 1.6m level verticals f/4 reasonably sharp room; 16:9 landscape. No people, human hands, lettering of any kind, readable or garbled text, labels, numbers, logos, watermark, plastic, screens, pentagrams, skulls, runes, occult eyes, black candles or spooky objects. Miniature dancer figurine is permitted as a music box mechanical ornament. Keep interactive objects distinct and uncluttered. Fixed room 4.5 x 4.5m: front lane-facing wall deep bay window and cushioned seat; spell table in front of bay; rear wall adjoining Cuddlecore book shelves; hill-side exterior wall fireplace with potion cabinet beside it; opposite hill wall is hallway with ONE old oak FOUR-panel door, cream frame, round aged brass knob. Facing front bay from the room, the hill fireplace wall is to the RIGHT and hallway wall to the LEFT. Camera near hallway door looking diagonally toward bay shows fireplace on right. Match the reference Inn's plaster, timber and workmanship. Standing just inside near hallway door, look diagonally across a heavy old oak pastry table toward the deep bay window overlooking wet village cottages at blue dusk. Large pale marble pastry slab on table; ceramic bowl with a metal balloon whisk suspended and turning by itself, handful of individual raspberries hovering just above, one thick physically believable glossy ribbon of dark chocolate curling mid-pour into bowl. Restrained tiny warm golden motes only. Table is dominant with readable negative space above it. Bay has cushioned rose window seat, thick plum velvet curtains drawn aside. On a small side table to the LEFT near bay, aged brass tiered cake stand holds small treats and on its broad TOP tier a little carved rose-and-gold wooden music box OPEN, tiny cream dancer upright inside, readable and gently spotlit. Four separate clear glass cloches on sideboard hold fruit tart, dark chocolate truffles, berry pavlova and yoghurt-fruit parfait; do not overcrowd spell table. On RIGHT hill wall visible rustic stone fireplace, small fire, copper sugar pan with slender rose steam; glass-front oak cabinet of ruby/amber syrup bottles softly glowing nearby. Plain books and open illustrated book on brass lectern glimpsed only where spatially plausible. Intimate working magician's room, quiet enchantment, no theatre stage. Photographic, tactile, gently surprising. Landscape 16:9.
assets.correction: Edit this room concept with TWO precise corrections; keep camera, composition, room geometry, table, magic, materials and lighting unchanged. 1) Replace ONLY the view outside the bay window: we are at a ground-floor window, facing directly across a narrow cobbled village lane running left-right, old cottages opposite at similar ground level, low stone wall, painted doors, window boxes, little bakery without sign, one lamp post, closed umbrellas in a doorway and a bicycle against a wall, wooded hills rising behind the roofs. Wet early-evening blue dusk. Absolutely NO SEA, harbour, boats or elevated overlook. No people or lettering. 2) The little open rose/gold wooden music box with cream dancer must sit ON THE BROAD TOP TIER of the brass tiered cake stand, NOT beside it on the round table. Make top tier broad enough for stable box, treats on lower tiers. Remove the duplicate original box from round tabletop. Rest of image identical. Photographic realism, no text, no numbers, no occult imagery.
assets.review: Corrected exterior to ground-floor lane; corrected music box onto cake stand. Master for room materials and props. Dedicated books and mechanical-detail views govern fine details.

assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset 14-lane-rain.png, composition master for a shared village-window backdrop. Output VERY WIDE panoramic landscape, exact 3:1 aspect ratio, ideally 3072x1024. Camera standing AT GROUND FLOOR eye height 1.6m at front of old English/Kiwi coastal countryside inn, looking straight ACROSS a narrow cobbled lane that runs horizontally LEFT TO RIGHT through the lower third, level horizon and level verticals. NO WINDOW, FRAME, GLASS, ROOM, CURTAINS OR FOREGROUND INN WALL visible. Across the lane a low rough stone wall with a gap, a row of 3-4 intimate old honey-grey stone cottages opposite, dark slate roofs with stone chimneys, painted sage/rose/blue doors, cream timber casement windows and flower-filled window boxes, modest climbing roses.
